# fertig

> A classless CSS stylesheet that ships components, not just styled elements.
> Link one file, write ordinary semantic HTML, and the page is finished —
> 36.7 KB raw, 8.6 KB gzipped, no build step, no dependencies, no JavaScript,
> no classes required.
>
> Menus, dialogs, drawers, toasts and tooltips are addressed by ARIA and work
> with JavaScript disabled, because they run on `popover`, `command` and CSS
> anchor positioning. Tabs are styled but not switched because `aria-selected`
> has to be a real attribute; panel visibility, roving focus and arrow keys need
> a small JavaScript controller. Do not use `<details>` as tabs: it is a native
> disclosure widget, not a tab widget.

fertig styles semantic HTML directly. There is no `.container`, no grid
system and no utility classes beyond the layout set below. If you are generating markup for a page that uses it,
write plain HTML and it will look designed. Reach for a class only from the
short list below.

## Accents

Put `data-accent` on any element to retint everything inside it — links, focus
rings, filled buttons, the caret, the selection. Values: `blue` (default),
`cyan`, `green`, `amber`, `red`, `violet`, `gray`. For anything else set `--fertig-ac`.

```html
<section data-accent="green"><button class="primary">Save</button></section>
```

## Setup

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fertig@4/fertig.min.css">
```

## Layout — the most important rule

Direct children of `<body>` are the containers. Do not add wrappers.

```html
<body>
  <nav>…</nav>       <!-- becomes a sticky, full-bleed toolbar -->
  <header>…</header> <!-- page heading and intro -->
  <main>…</main>     <!-- the content -->
  <footer>…</footer>
</body>
```

Body-level containers are full width. Put `.max-w-prose` on long-form content for a
38rem reading measure; for an extra-wide app screen, put
`.wide` on the container. `--fertig-g` controls the responsive page gutter,
which scales from 1.15rem on narrow phones to 1.9rem on larger screens.

## The only classes (all optional)

`.row` flex row, wrapping and gapped · `.grid` auto-fit columns · `.card`
raised panel, takes an optional `<header>` and `<footer>` · `.badge` pill label
· `.muted` secondary text · `.center` centre text · `.wide` widen a container.
Plus `.primary` for a filled button, which `type="submit"` already gets.

## Components use semantic HTML and ARIA, not classes

- Segmented control: `<div role="group">` of buttons with `aria-pressed`
- ARIA tabs: `<div role="tablist">` + `<button role="tab" aria-selected>`; script owns state and arrow keys
- Switch: `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`
- Menu: `<button popovertarget="m">` + `<div popover id="m"><menu>…`
- Dialog: `<dialog id="d" closedby="any">` opened with
  `<button commandfor="d" command="show-modal">` — no JavaScript.
  An optional `<header>` (the title) and `<footer>` (the actions) run
  edge to edge and stay pinned while the body scrolls. A `<p>` first in the
  footer becomes a note and pushes the buttons to the end edge.
- Breadcrumb: `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"><ol>`
- Loading: `aria-busy="true"` · Tooltip: `data-tooltip="…"`
- Tone anything: `data-tone="ok|warn|err"` on a badge, aside, card or button
- Buttons: `data-variant="ghost|link"`, `data-size="sm|lg"`, `data-icon`,
  `data-block`
- Layout utilities: `.flex` `.flex-col` `.flex-wrap`
  `.flex-1` `.grid-cols-2|3|4` `.items-start|center|end`
  `.justify-start|center|end|between` `.gap-0|1|2|3|4|6` `.mx-auto` `.ms-auto`
  `.me-auto` `.w-full` `.hidden`, plus the whole max-width scale
  `.max-w-xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl|4xl|5xl|6xl|7xl|full|none|prose`.
  Layout and width only — no colour/type scale, no responsive variants.
  Margins are flow-relative, so RTL keeps working.
- A `<nav>`'s first control after the `<ul>` sits at the far end by itself, and
  a `<label>` following a field gets its own top margin — neither needs a style
  attribute

## Tokens worth overriding

`--fertig-ac` accent · `--fertig-on-ac` text on the accent (computed automatically where
`contrast-color()` exists) · `--fertig-w` the toolbar content width · `--fertig-g` the page gutter · `--fertig-r` control radius · `--fertig-f`
font stack. Also `--fertig-bg` `--fertig-el` `--fertig-face` `--fertig-fg` `--fertig-mut` `--fertig-bd`, the elevation
scale `--fertig-up` `--fertig-up2` `--fertig-dn`, and `--fertig-rw` large-surface radius.

Dark mode is one `light-dark()` token block. Add `data-theme="dark"` or
`"light"` on `<html>` to override the OS.

## Things that already work, so do not hand-roll them

- Right-aligned numeric columns: `<td align="right">`; totals go in `<tfoot>`
- Form controls inside `.row` size to the row, so filter bars lay out inline
- Required and read-only fields, autofill, validation (`:user-invalid`)
- Tables scroll themselves below 40rem
- Print styles, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `prefers-contrast`, `forced-colors`,
  `pointer: coarse` (44px targets), and safe-area insets

## Overriding

The sheet declares `@layer fertig, fertig-a11y` (the second holds the
forced-colors block, so it wins on layer order rather than `!important`). Any
unlayered CSS you write beats both regardless of specificity.

```css
button { background: hotpink }   /* wins */
```

## Files

- fertig.css: commented source
- fertig.min.css: minified, what you serve
- index.html: landing page
- docs.html: full documentation
- blocks.html: ready-to-use markup blocks

## Right-to-left

Set `dir="rtl"` and the sheet mirrors: it is written in logical properties
(`padding-inline-start`, `border-inline-start`, `text-align: start`, logical
border radii), with `:dir(rtl)` rules for the two things that cannot be
logical (the switch knob's `translate`, the select chevron's background
position). Utilities are `ms`/`me`, never `ml`/`mr`.

## Browser support

The two-year window is on browsers, not on CSS. Floor: Chrome 123 (light-dark),
Safari 17.5 (light-dark, @starting-style, text-wrap: balance), Firefox 129
(@starting-style, transition-behavior) — i.e. anything released since
August 2024. The required CSS is mostly older
than the window: @layer cross-engine since 2022, oklch()/color-mix() since
2023, light-dark() since May 2024, @starting-style since August 2024. Nothing the
sheet requires shipped inside the last two years. No component needs more than
the floor.

No polyfills and no fallback build. The only vendor prefixes are the three no
engine has replaced: -webkit-text-size-adjust, the -webkit-text-fill-color
autofill repaint, and the progress pseudo-elements. The only concession to
browsers below the floor is a @supports not (color: light-dark()) block
restating the palette in flat sRGB, so those engines land on a plain readable
page instead of invalid colour tokens.

Two cosmetic properties are above the floor and deliberately ungated:
scrollbar-color and accent-color (Safari 26.2). Nothing to fall back to,
nothing breaks.

Everything past the floor is behind @supports and additive, with first
shipping versions Chrome/Safari/Firefox: anchor positioning 129/26/147,
anchor-size() + position-visibility 125/26.2/147, relative colour
oklch(from ...) 122/18/128 (filled-button hover only; shadow alphas use
color-mix instead), field-sizing 123/26.2/152,
::details-content 131/18.4/143, interpolate-size 129/-/-, contrast-color()
147/26/146, text-box: trim-both 133/18.2/154, appearance: base-select
135/27/-, ::spelling-error 121/17.4/-, text-wrap: pretty
117/26/-.

## Known limit

ARIA tabs are styled, but selection, roving focus, panel visibility, and arrow
keys require the small controller shown in the documentation. CSS cannot update
ARIA state honestly.
